request.prompt: Write a complete original instrumental for an atmospheric futuristic electric-car radio station. Strictly no voices, singing, speech, vocal chops, choir, whispers, or vocoder. Original melodies and sound design only; no quotations or samples of existing music. Polished warm stereo mix, controlled bass, smooth high frequencies, and space for vehicle sound effects. Start with an established pulse, develop a restrained recurring motif, vary the arrangement every eight bars, keep momentum throughout, and end on the ongoing groove without silence or a dramatic finale. Fast atmospheric dub techno at 130 BPM, 4/4, approximately 48 bars. Precise four-on-the-floor electronic drums, deep driving bass pulse, shuffled closed hats, clipped rim percussion, icy chord stabs through warm tape delay. A futuristic city tunnel accelerating into long blue light trails. A hypnotic evolving minor-chord sequence, occasional sparkling high arpeggios and strong rhythmic forward motion. Understated, spacious and cinematic, never abrasive.
